create_rnn_agent: create an RNNAgent instance with input_shape and args containing rnn_hidden_dim and n_actions
init_hidden_states: call init_hidden on an RNNAgent to get zero-initialized hidden states on the correct device
forward_pass_rnn: run a forward pass through the RNNAgent with inputs and hidden_state to get Q-values and new hidden state
review_rnn_agent_architecture: review the RNNAgent class which uses fc1, GRUCell, and fc2 layers for sequential decision making
refactor_rnn_agent_layers: refactor the RNNAgent forward method to add dropout or batch normalization between layers
